profile.summary: Degenkolb Engineers is a structural engineering firm. It provides structural design concepts, building systems support, delegated designs and construction engineering services. It also does seismic (earthquake) engineering, forensic analysis and structural consulting. It has offices in the U.S. and elsewhere, with corporate headquarters in San Francisco.
